name: command
title: Command
description: A command palette whose highlight glides between results, with filtered items that reflow, a height-animated list, and a ⌘K dialog.

useCases: App-wide command menus opened with ⌘K, and inline searchable action lists such as quick switchers or settings pickers.
limitations: Filtering runs on the client over the rendered items, so large or remote result sets should be filtered by the caller. Item values must be unique. Nested pages and multi-select are not built in.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give every CommandItem a unique string value. Put a Command inside CommandDialog; the dialog closes when an item runs. Reduced motion moves the highlight, list height, and results instantly and opens the dialog without the spring.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/command.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
